method: Independent qualitative assessment against recorded run metrics, configuration and chart, with no paid judge, model call or backtest. Quality pass requires truthful, useful, appropriately scoped model prose; safe fallback is a model-quality failure. No arbitrary word cap. Baseline accepted text is private composer output, not baseline UI. Candidate fallback complete_text is private deterministic prose; the reader uses its localized template.
interpretation_notes: issues concern accepted complete text, or the generation fallback itself. raw_only_issues concern suppressed drafts and must not be reported as visible leakage.
language_ok, figures_and_benchmark_ok and compliance describe the accepted draft where present, otherwise the recorded raw draft. Null means no raw draft was available.
causal_claim includes unsupported performance attribution, such as asserting that the strategy missed the benchmark's strongest rally periods without its price path.
